notes.title: FPS Limiting & Quality of life changes
notes.notes:
-FPS now limits at 144 (Prevents excessive fps when streaming/recording)

-Extra subtitles to explain more context in certain situations (tells the player to listen for breathing before opening doors)

-Fixed a bug where the broken window sound effect can play more than once

notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.notes:
The first round of quality-of-life changes

-Fixed window escape achievement (did not work previously)

-Changed remote appearance to make it easier to find

-Added additional lighting to findable objects

-Added "Quit" and "Menu" buttons on the end game screen
